title: User
description: A Microsoft Entra ID user account managed via Microsoft Graph

displayName.description: Name displayed in the address book for the user

mail.description: Primary SMTP address for the user

givenName.description: Given name (first name) of the user

surname.description: Surname (family name or last name) of the user

department.description: Department name in which the user works

officeLocation.description: Office location in the user's place of business

mobilePhone.description: Primary cellular telephone number for the user

accountEnabled.description: True if the account is enabled; otherwise false

usageLocation.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166) required for license assignment

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the user (ISO 639-1 Code, e.g. en-US)

createdDateTime.description: Date and time the user was created

lastPasswordChangeDateTime.description: Timestamp of the last password change

passwordPolicies.description: Password policies enforced for the user

userType.description: Whether the user is a member or guest in the tenant

onPremisesSyncEnabled.description: True if the user is synchronized from on-premises Active Directory

onPremisesDistinguishedName.description: Distinguished name from on-premises Active Directory

externalUserState.description: State of a guest/external user invited via Azure AD B2B
